summary: Frontend-only smoke + functional E2E completed against the public preview URL. All 11 features in the review request pass: Landing page renders hero/radar/features/pipeline/safety/CTA/footer; nav-launch routes to /dashboard; sidebar with active highlighting works on every internal route; Dashboard shows Mission Control header, tabs, overview-panel by default and switches to SVG line chart (Trends, 23 SVGs detected) and timeline (Activity); Scans page filters by status (all=7, completed=5) and by search 'lab'=3; Assets grid has 24 cards, Alive filter reduces to 20; Findings list shows 10 rows, clicking opens drawer, X closes it, Critical filter -> 3 rows; Reports lists 5 items, clicking updates right panel; Monitoring shows health-list with sparklines (22 SVGs); Integrations has 6 toggles that flip visual state on click; Settings save button updates 'Saved at' label. Demo banner is visible on every internal page (informational, not error-styled). Landing screenshot confirms beautiful navy+accent theme with radar, gradient hero, glassmorphism cards. No layout/contrast issues observed.
critical_code_review_comments: client.ts hardcodes fallback API base 'http://localhost:8000' when VITE_API_BASE_URL is not set; consider failing fast or using a relative '/api' fallback so demo mode is the only path in preview (current behaviour still works because fetch throws and NetworkUnavailableError triggers demo fallback).
Integration toggles flip via class change but do not set aria-checked / data-state; adding aria-checked='true|false' on the toggle button would improve a11y and testability.
Sidebar generates data-testid via item.to.replace('/', '') which is fragile for nested routes; safe today since all routes are top-level.
seed_data_creation: none; app uses built-in DEMO_* dataset because backend is unreachable in preview (intentional per request)
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a frontend-only Vite+React+TS app at the preview root. Backend (FastAPI:8001) is intentionally unreachable; demo fallback is triggered via NetworkUnavailableError in /app/frontend/src/shared/api/client.ts and demo banner [data-testid='demo-banner'] is shown on every internal page. Do NOT flag backend connection-refused console errors as bugs - they are how the demo path is reached. All data-testids present: nav-launch, hero-launch, cta-launch, sidebar, nav-{dashboard|scans|assets|findings|reports|monitoring|integrations|settings}, demo-banner, dashboard-tabs, tab-{overview|trends|activity}, overview-panel, scans-search, scans-tab-{all|running|completed|failed}, assets-grid, assets-search, finding-row-*, findings-tab-critical, report-item-*, health-list, toggle-* (6 items), settings-form, settings-save.
console_errors_observed: Only repeated 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED' from API calls to localhost:8000 - expected demo-mode trigger, NOT a bug per reviewer instructions. No JS pageerror exceptions, no React warnings.
